adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens` to avoid using local refresh tokens when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set (used across Google/O365/Zoom/etc.). In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new refresh flow still does a direct `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token")` and sends `refresh_token: credentialKey.refresh_token` without using `refreshOAuthTokens`. Under credential sharing, other code paths may no longer have a real `refresh_token` locally (see `parseRefreshTokenResponse` defaulting `refresh_token`), so Salesforce both bypasses the intended external refresh mechanism and may break in that mode by sending an invalid/placeholder refresh token to Salesforce.
